name: SCG
h1: From agentic AI plans to connected operations
lede: SCG is building agentic AI with FPT, optimising Thai and Vietnamese operations together and holding firm on financial discipline. Airtable gives those programmes one connected operating layer.
why_h2: Building strength across a regional portfolio
why_p: SCG's 2026 agenda pairs cost discipline with new AI and regional programmes, each spanning several businesses.

signals.title: SCG and FPT sign an agentic AI MOU
signals.body: SCG and FPT agreed to work on AI transformation, agentic AI, intelligent operations and ERP consulting across chemicals, cement and building materials, packaging and logistics.
signals.angle: AI agents need structured, permissioned workflow data to act on. Airtable gives teams that layer without waiting on a full ERP change.

signals.title: Vietnam revenue up 99 per cent in Q1
signals.body: SCG's Q1 2026 Vietnam revenue reached about US$597 million, driven by Long Son Petrochemicals restarting, while the plant was set to pause from mid-May due to the Middle East crisis.
signals.angle: Fast swings in plant status ripple into sales, supply and finance plans. One shared tracker keeps every team on the same version.

signals.title: 2025 results: EBITDA up, debt down
signals.body: SCG reported adjusted EBITDA up six per cent and debt reduced by US$428 million, despite revenue down three per cent amid global headwinds and volatile energy prices.
signals.angle: Cost programmes stick when initiatives, owners and savings are tracked in one place rather than in separate spreadsheets.

signals.title: A 2026 target above 500 billion baht
signals.body: CEO Thammasak Sethaudom set a goal of 1 to 3 per cent revenue growth in 2026, surpassing 500 billion baht, with adjusted EBITDA expected to exceed the 2025 level.
signals.angle: Group targets break down into many business-unit initiatives. Airtable connects them so progress rolls up without manual reporting.
